evidence: SQLite-only: `'`''a"'.id` qualifies a column with a string literal, which SQLite reads as an identifier in that position; PostgreSQL and ANSI SQL never take a string as a qualifier. The grammar reads that term as the literal `'`''a"'`, an ERROR at `.`, then the alias `id` (tree checked with the vendored grammar), so the file has a syntax error and the engine reports nothing on it (T1).
